name: command
title: Command
description: A box to type in over a list of actions and places, on the #262626 overlay surface: the field on top over a hairline, groups with a capital label, the menus' rows with an icon and a shortcut. On the page, or in a window opened with Cmd+K. The list scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.
use_for: Jumping anywhere and running anything from the keyboard: searches, boards, brands, settings. CommandDialog for the app-wide Cmd+K menu.
never: Motion on opening or closing: it opens many times a day
Tab between rows: the field keeps focus and the arrows move
A spectrum color on the highlighted row
The only way to an action: keep it in the interface too
source: Derived from the guidelines: the #262626 card fill on Black, neutral hairlines, the 10px canvas corner (8px here), DM Sans 14px rows, capital labels at 6%. shadcn's command (cmdk) for anatomy, filtering and keys.
body:
Rows are data: `groups` of `{ heading, items: [{ id, label, keywords, shortcut, icon, disabled }] }`. In the web
component, a row's icon is page content with `slot="icon-<id>"`.
